henry.title: Daily Executive Briefing
henry.summary: Independent continuity briefing. The GitHub lane is live now; the Workspace Apps Script path is the fastest route to branded daily email and real approval buttons without a ChatGPT dependency.
topPriorities: Activate the Workspace-restricted daily briefing email and approval runtime
Verify Henry and Destiny's separate internal delivery lanes
Maintain the external-outreach hold until wrapped-email QA passes

decisions.text: Deploy and install the Google Workspace daily briefing runtime
Keep Cloudflare activation as the secondary resilience lane after Workspace email is live
Keep external outreach paused until the wrapped-email release gate passes

risks: Branded email is not live until the Workspace web app is deployed and the one-time installer runs
The Cloudflare runtime remains blocked while deployment credentials are unavailable
No briefing approval authorizes an external campaign release unless the separate governing release gate permits it

nextActions.text: Run the controlled Henry and Destiny email delivery test
Verify approve-all, approve-selected, individual approval, and duplicate prevention

destiny.title: Daily Coordinator Briefing
destiny.summary: Separate coordinator continuity briefing. Henry's private calendar and private decision data are not copied into this lane by default.
topPriorities: Review the coordinator queue and surface decisions requiring Henry
Protect candidate, client, and meeting follow-through from missed handoffs

decisions.text: Keep external outreach on hold until Henry releases the wrapped-email standard

risks: Do not treat unverified queue or calendar data as a live commitment

nextActions.text: Complete the morning coordinator queue review
